about.heading: An Academic Reference Built for Curious Botanists and Growers
paragraphs: Plantipedia transforms botanical reference literature into a structured, high-contrast digital museum. Every entry pairs classical taxonomic rigor—from family lineage and floral morphology to pollination syndromes—with practical agronomic guidance rooted in South Asian, tropical, and global growing traditions.

Curated cleanly across 50 documented plant species with 15 Botanical Chapters per Plant and connected via a 6-source zero-key uplink to a 1,600,000+ (1.6M+) Global Flora & Tree Collection, the archive delivers context-matched monographs backed by verified photography, bilingual EN / বাংলা nomenclature, and print-ready field sheets.

globalGateway.heading: Global Botanical Server Gateway
paragraphs: While Plantipedia's core archive curates 50 deeply authored 15-chapter botanical monographs, the living plant kingdom spans more than 1,600,000+ (1.6M+) plant and tree taxa indexed across 6 federated botanical databases (GBIF Backbone, MediaWiki, Wikidata, iNaturalist, EOL, and Open Tree of Life). This lookup console links directly to the Global Botanical Server so every search resolves accepted Linnaean binomials, hierarchical classifications, and verified field photography on demand.

Every query bypasses the local 50-species index without API keys or paywalls—aggregating 6-source taxonomic graphs, cross-script English and বাংলা vernacular matching with zero-key auto-translation, and biome-calibrated cultivation telemetry ready for full-page reading or split-screen comparison.

backbones.label: GBIF Backbone
backbones.detail: Resolves accepted Kingdom Plantae binomials, synonym keys, and authoritative global occurrence hierarchies.

backbones.label: Global Flora Index
backbones.detail: Synthesizes structured 15-chapter morphological, ecological, and ethnobotanical prose across worldwide taxa.

backbones.label: Wikidata Graph
backbones.detail: Bridges persistent P225 taxonomic nodes with bilingual EN / বাংলা nomenclature and IUCN Red List statuses.

backbones.label: iNaturalist Taxa
backbones.detail: Supplies research-grade field specimen plates covering floral structures, foliage, bark, and natural habitats.

backbones.label: EOL TraitBank
backbones.detail: Contributes functional trait records, ecological habit descriptions, and vernacular biodiversity synonyms.

backbones.label: Open Tree of Life
backbones.detail: Cross-verifies evolutionary clade hierarchies, phylogenetic lineage nodes, and synthetic taxon ancestry.
